message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: Defendant Cha (查某某) contracted a fire restaurant renovation for 240,000 yuan. From Nov to Dec 2015, he hired workers (Liu, Zhong, etc.) for renovation. After completion, he received 220,000 yuan of payment and left. He paid some labor wages but still owed 57,000 yuan to ten workers. The labor bureau ordered payment. Cha escaped and refused to pay. After police case, he paid the owed wages. So the crime is refusing to pay labor remuneration (refusing to pay labor wages). The list includes "拒不支付劳动报酬". That matches.

Thus single charge: 拒不支付劳动报酬.
